Replies from my own AnkiConnect, saved as it returned them (the `result` of each call):

- `notes-info-kelev-chatul-dag.json`: `notesInfo` for כלב, חתול and דג, the notes that follow the
  current conventions.
- `notes-info-bayit.json`: `notesInfo` for the five notes `"Hebrew:*בית*"` finds.
- `model-field-names-hebrew.json`: `modelFieldNames` for the `Hebrew` note type.
